context_definition.alignment: same second 10ms source sample and within-block pairs as V7
context_definition.behavior_access: separate context sidecar; never returned by feature-only loading
context_definition.trial_id: provider go interval ordinal; -1 outside a paired single go interval
context_definition.trial_age_seconds: (second source-bin index - provider go start index) * 0.01
context_definition.trial_onset_seconds: exact 10ms go onset on the accumulated exposed 20ms clock
context_definition.trial_bounds: first and exclusive last complete 20ms pair within go, clipped to exposure
context_definition.trial_right_censored: provider go end extends beyond the selected exposed segment
context_definition.onset: direction and distance at provider go start; zero direction if invalid
context_definition.reference40: direction and distance at go start+4 source bins; unavailable outside exposed go
context_definition.target_meaning: cursor-to-target geometry, not measured limb velocity or independent intention
